doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification - Foundation & Monorepo Setup
doc.section: Data Models and Contracts - Root tsconfig.json Structure
doc.snippet: Defines root tsconfig.json with composite: true, declaration: true, declarationMap: true, and references array. Specifies project references pattern for cross-package type checking and incremental builds.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Package tsconfig extends root config with composite: true, outDir: ./dist, rootDir: ./src. Each package has independent compilation unit with project references for cross-package imports.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR57: Core types separated from provider types
doc.snippet: Core Holo types separated from provider-specific types enables clear boundaries and type safety across packages without circular dependencies.

doc.title: Holo Architecture
doc.snippet: Proposed structure uses TypeScript composite projects for monorepo organization. Clear boundaries enable core extraction as standalone library. Dependency flow: server → api → core → nothing.

doc.title: Epics Document
doc.snippet: Technical notes specify TypeScript composite projects (no path aliases per Architecture ADR-001), root tsconfig with composite: true and references array, packages can reference each other using package names.

doc.title: Story 1.1 - Create Monorepo Workspace Structure (COMPLETED)
doc.snippet: Workspace configuration complete: npm workspaces added to package.json, private flag set, .gitignore updated. Build and test infrastructure verified stable. Foundation ready for TypeScript configuration.

constraints.constraint: MUST enable "composite": true in root tsconfig.json to support project references
MUST add "declaration": true and "declarationMap": true for type declarations required by composite projects
MUST add "references": [] array to root tsconfig.json (will be populated when packages are added)
MUST exclude packages/ directory from root tsconfig to prevent double compilation
MUST NOT use TypeScript path aliases - rely on workspace resolution (Architecture ADR-001)
Each workspace package tsconfig must extend root config with "extends": "../../tsconfig.json"
Each workspace package tsconfig must have "composite": true for incremental builds
NFR-EPIC1-2: IDE must show type errors within 2 seconds of code change
NFR-EPIC1-5: All existing integration tests must pass after changes
NFR-EPIC1-1: Build performance must be <30 seconds initial, <5 seconds incremental

interface.name: TypeScript composite projects configuration
interface.notes: Root configuration enables project references. References array will list package paths as they are added (e.g., [{ "path": "./packages/common" }]).

interface.name: Workspace package tsconfig template
interface.notes: Each package extends root config and declares its own references to dependent packages. Enables cross-package type checking and incremental compilation.

interface.name: TypeScript build command
interface.notes: The --build flag enables incremental compilation and respects project references. Compiles packages in dependency order automatically.

tests.standards: Testing framework: Jest with ts-jest preset for TypeScript support. Tests located in tests/ directory with pattern **/*.test.ts. Integration tests use testTimeout=30000 and runInBand flag. Existing test: tests/integration/providers/openai.test.ts validates provider functionality. All tests must pass after TypeScript configuration changes to ensure no regression (AC validation, NFR-EPIC1-5).
